overview: Project Meadow is a decentralized, community-first platform on the Internet Computer connecting Canadian local businesses, food producers, tradespeople, services, non-profits, cooperatives, and community members. It fosters local economic resilience through a trusted directory, community opportunities coordination, connected presence links, and lightweight coordination infrastructure — strictly non-custodial and community-oriented.
features: Searchable local business and producer directory with map/grid view
Connected Presence profiles — link websites, social channels, stores, and resources
Featured content highlighting on member profiles
Community Opportunities system — post and discover volunteer work, workshops, farm exchanges, mentorship
Community Trust System with confirm/report voting and auto-verification
Optional membership support tiers with interest capture (no payment processing)
Admin panel with approval workflow, trust moderation, and opportunity management
Activity feed showing live local participation events
Chapter map showing active cities with member counts
Wallet education for Bitcoin and ICP payment display (no custody)
Mobile-first dark premium UI with cream typography and Font Awesome icons
